yaml.title: About Me
yaml.description: *I have over 7 years of hands-on experience in optical systems, spanning free-space optical communications, high-power fiber lasers, nonlinear frequency conversion, and precision industrial sensing. *

markdown.headingText: {{< iconify material-symbols:satellite-alt >}} Free Space Optical Communications
markdown.markdown:
- Primary optical architect for satellite laser communication payloads, sub-$\mu\text{rad}$ PAT subsystems, and ground-station receivers. - Built an end-to-end PAT acquisition testbed and validated multi-km terrestial optical communication link. - Designed sub-$\mu\text{rad}$ QPD/FSM closed-loop tracking loops for rapid beam acquisition and platform jitter rejection. - Conducted space-qualification vendor evaluations, transmitter/beacon selection, and end-to-end SNR/BER optical link budget modeling aligned with SDA OCT and CCSDS standards. #### {{< iconify material-symbols:stylus-laser-pointer >}} High-Power Fiber Lasers - Architected custom high-power amplifier chains across Yb-, Er-, and Raman-doped gain media. - Developed linewidth-reduced cascaded Raman fiber laser architectures achieving a 5× improvement in spectral density with >99% spectral purity. - Designed reflective Fourier pulse shaper and free-space optical filters for laser cavity spectral control. - Performed custom specialty fiber processing, precision fusion splicing, and multi-element optical train alignment. #### {{< iconify material-symbols:palette >}} Nonlinear Frequency Conversion - Developed frequency-doubled single-mode visible CW laser sources continuously tunable from 530–720 nm (>100 mW green, ~70 mW yellow, ~55 mW red, <100 GHz linewidth). - Extended cascaded Raman lasers into the blue-violet spectral window for high-power spectroscopy applications. - Built passively Q-switched pulsed Raman laser platforms widely tunable across the second NIR and visible windows for hyperspectral photoacoustic imaging. - Optimized non-linear frequency conversion chains using phase-matched BBO, LBO, and PPLN crystals. #### {{< iconify material-symbols:factory >}} Precesion Industrial Sensing - Co-invented a spectrally shaped supercontinuum based non-contact thermal monitoring system for in-process silicon wafers. - Achieved best-in-class $\pm 1^\circ\text{C}$ temperature measurement accuracy in direct collaboration with a leading semiconductor equipment manufacturer (patent filed). - Designed multi-point optomechanical illumination optics, pyrometry collection trains, and custom spectral shaping hardware. ## {{< iconify game-icons:skills>}} Technical Skills - [**Free-Space & Space Optics**]{.underline}: FSOC Terminal Architecture, Link Budgeting, Space Qualification, SDA OCT / CCSDS Standards - [**Control Systems**]{.underline}: QPD Signal Chain Design, FSM Closed-Loop Control, Sub-$\mu\text{rad}$ Tracking, Platform Jitter Rejection - [**Fiber laser**]{.underline}: Design and fabrication of fiber lasers (CW and pulsed), Raman fiber lasers, and amplifiers - [**Fiber processing**]{.underline}: stripping, cleaving, splicing, recoating of normal and specialty fibers - [**Nonlinear conversion**]{.underline}: Freq. doubling using nonlinear crystals - BBO, LBO, PPLN - [**Free-space setups**]{.underline}: pulse shapers, grating filters, beam combiners, collimators, and coupling systems - [**Simulations**]{.underline}: link budget, propagation through turbulence, fiber lasers, Raman lasers, nonlinear pulse propagation, harmonic generation and free-space optics - [**Softwares**]{.underline}: Python, Julia, Mathematica, COMSOL, Zemax, OptiSystem, FreeCad ## {{< iconify material-symbols:work >}} Experience ::::: columns ::: {.column width="30%"} **Founding Optical Engineer** ::: ::: column QOSMIC Satellite Systems Pvt.
